key_decisions.rationale: Keeps direct singular address, inference, judicial wordplay, self-condemnation, and identical conduct.
key_decisions.before: Therefore you are without excuse, whoever you are who judges. For in judging someone else, you condemn yourself, because you who judge practice the same things.
key_decisions.after: Therefore you are without excuse, whoever you are who judges. For in judging someone else, you condemn yourself, because you who judge practice the same things.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, every one who judges; for in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself, for you who judge practice the same things.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps hearing/doing contrast, divine presence, and future justification language.
key_decisions.before: For it is not the hearers of the Law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the Law who will be set right.
key_decisions.after: For it is not the hearers of the Law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the Law who will be declared righteous.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for not the hearers of the law are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Gentile identity, absence of Torah, nature/instinct, actual doing, and reflexive law relation.
key_decisions.before: When Gentiles who do not have the Law do by nature the things of the Law, they are a law to themselves even though they do not have the Law.
key_decisions.after: For whenever Gentiles who do not have the Law do instinctively what the Law requires, these people, though not having the Law, are a law to themselves.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature the things of the law, these, though not having the law, are a law to themselves,

key_decisions.rationale: Supplies the implied temporal connection while preserving day, gospel, divine judgment, secrets, and mediation.
key_decisions.before: This will be on the day when God judges people’s hidden things through Christ Jesus, according to my good news.
key_decisions.after: This will be evident on the day when, according to my good news, God judges people's secrets through Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: on the day when God judges the secrets of men through Jesus Christ, according to my gospel.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps conditional benefit, action, violation, and status reversal.
key_decisions.before: Circumcision is indeed valuable if you practice the Law, but if you break the Law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
key_decisions.after: Circumcision is indeed beneficial if you practice the Law; but if you break the Law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For circumcision indeed profits if you practice the law; but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps inward identity, heart metaphor, Spirit/letter contrast, praise wordplay, and divine source.
key_decisions.before: Rather, a Jew is one inwardly, and circumcision is of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a person’s praise comes not from people but from God.
key_decisions.after: Rather, a person is Jewish inwardly, and circumcision is of the heart—by the Spirit, not by the written code. That person's praise comes not from people but from God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is of the heart, in spirit, not in letter, whose praise is not from men but from God.
